content.title: Pescao (2024)
about: Pescao is a short film created for the Audiovisual Narrative course at CITM (UPC). A group of students travel to a lake to shoot a class film, but their new teammate (Lin) starts acting strangely — escalating the story from mystery to action and finally a slasher.

The project involved moodboards, multiple script iterations, on-location shooting (15:00–23:00) near Terrassa, and a collaborative edit where each team member edited specific scenes before the final assembly.
features: On-location production with a small crew and practical props
Montage editing techniques (collage, sound montage, continuous action, movement)
learnings: Planning production with limited time and resources (location, props, schedule)
Coordinating a collaborative edit pipeline and maintaining continuity between scenes
Building tension through pacing, sound, and POV choices
